series.name: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)
series.notes: Separate battery-side alarm table in the same EMEA guide, numbered 1-17 with short alarm names (not app error codes). Applies to lithium packs with BMS communication. It collides with SERIES 3 / 4 / 5 integers: battery 1 is 'High battery temperature' while ES-US 1 is Utility Loss and ESS app 01 is AC HCT Check Failure. The table's troubleshooting column is a single merged cell covering rows 1, 15-17, so per-row wording is limited to what the guide actually states.

meaning.en: The battery pack is running too hot, most often because it is being pushed beyond its rating.
meaning.ur: Battery pack bohat garm chal raha hai, aam tor par is liye ke us ki rating se zyada load daala ja raha hai.

causes.en: Battery overloaded by charge or discharge demand.
causes.ur: Charge ya discharge demand ki wajah se battery overloaded hai.
Battery cabinet ki ventilation kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the charge and discharge power in the app and watch the temperature fall.
solutions.ur: App par charge aur discharge power kam karein aur temperature girte dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure battery temperature with an IR thermometer and compare with the BMS reading.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se battery temperature measure karke BMS reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery cabinet is not in direct sun and has airflow on all sides.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery cabinet direct dhoop mein nahi aur charon taraf airflow hai.

solutions.en: If the problem persists, contact the after-sales service.
solutions.ur: Agar masla barqarar rahe to after-sales service se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

meaning.en: Ambient is too cold for the battery to run, so the BMS blocks charge or discharge.
meaning.ur: Battery chalne ke liye ambient bohat thanda hai, is liye BMS charge ya discharge rok deta hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature below the battery's permitted range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature battery ki allowed range se neeche hai.

causes.en: Battery cabinet exposed to cold airflow or a night-time temperature drop below the pack's permitted minimum.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet thande hawa ya raat ke temperature girne ke mutabiq pack ki minimum limit se neeche jaa raha hai.

solutions.en: Check ambient at the battery cabinet with a thermometer; in winter expect protection, not damage.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se battery cabinet ka ambient check karein, sarshaat mein protection normal hai nuqsan nahi.

solutions.en: Keep the cabinet away from cold airflow and improve enclosure insulation.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ko thande hawa se door rakhein aur enclosure ki insulation behtar karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery chemistry's low-temperature charge limit before enabling charging again.
solutions.ur: Dobara charge enable karne se pehle battery chemistry ka low-temperature charge limit confirm karein.

notes.en: Never charge a lithium pack below its permitted low-temperature limit - plating is irreversible.
notes.ur: Lithium pack ko us ki low-temperature limit se neeche kabhi charge na karein, plating permanent nuqsan hai.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

title.ur: Battery cells ke voltage mein farq (3)

meaning.en: Individual cell voltages inside the pack have drifted apart beyond the permitted spread.
meaning.ur: Pack ke andar mukhtalif cells ke voltage ki farq allowed se zyada ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Cell imbalance from ageing or a single weak cell.
causes.ur: Bhaaran ya kisi aik kamzor cell ki wajah se cell imbalance.
Cell voltage sensing line ka fault.

solutions.en: Read per-cell voltages from the BMS in the app and find the outlier cell.
solutions.ur: App se BMS ki per-cell voltage readings parhein aur koi aik unusual cell dhoondein.

solutions.en: If the spread is small, run the pack's balancing/charge-refresh cycle per the battery manual.
solutions.ur: Agar farq kam ho to battery manual ke mutabiq pack ka balancing ya charge refresh cycle chalayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the cell voltage sense harness connectors for a loose pin.
solutions.ur: Cell voltage sense harness ke connectors mein dhila pin check karein.

solutions.en: If it persists, contact the after-sales service - cells are not field-serviceable.
solutions.ur: Agar masla rahe to after-sales service se rabta karein, cells field level par repair nahi hote.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

title.ur: Battery ka SOC neeche gir gaya (7)

meaning.en: State of charge has fallen below the usable minimum, so the inverter will not discharge the pack further.
meaning.ur: State of charge minimum se neeche gir chuka hai, is liye inverter pack aur discharge nahi karega.

causes.en: SOC fell below the configured depth-of-discharge limit.
causes.ur: SOC configured depth-of-discharge limit se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: PV has not been producing enough to recharge the pack.
causes.ur: PV itna generate nahi kar raha ke pack recharge ho sake.

solutions.en: Confirm PV is actually producing by reading live PV power in the app.
solutions.ur: App se live PV power parh ke confirm karein ke PV actually generate kar raha hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the SOC lower limit and the I-DOD setting in the app are what you intended.
solutions.ur: App par SOC lower limit aur I-DOD setting check karein ke jo aap chahte hain wahi hai.

solutions.en: If PV works properly but the fault persists, contact the after-sales service.
solutions.ur: Agar PV theek chal raha hai phir bhi masla rahe to after-sales service se rabta karein.

notes.en: GoodWe packs also stop discharging below roughly 20% SOC and only resume after a recharge hysteresis, so a low SOC is often protection rather than a fault.
notes.ur: GoodWe packs bhi taqreeban 20% SOC se neeche discharge band kar dete hain aur recharge ke baad hi dobara chalte hain, is liye low SOC aksar protection hai fault nahi.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

meaning.en: The inverter is not getting valid data from the BMS, so it will not charge or discharge the pack.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko BMS se valid data nahi mil raha, is liye woh pack charge ya discharge nahi karega.

causes.en: Battery communication cable loose, damaged or wrong pinout.
causes.ur: Battery communication cable dhili, damaged ya ghalat pinout wali hai.

causes.en: Incompatible firmware on the battery or the inverter.
causes.ur: Battery ya inverter par incompatible firmware hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery is switched on and its own status LEDs show a healthy state.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke battery on hai aur us ke status LEDs healthy state dikha rahe hain.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat both ends of the BMS CAN cable and check the polarity and pinout.
solutions.ur: Power off karke BMS CAN cable ke dono ends dobara lagayein aur polarity aur pinout check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery model selected in the app matches the installed pack; a mismatch blocks comms.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke app mein select kiya hua battery model installed pack se match karta hai, mismatch par comms band ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Update the battery and inverter firmware to the versions the supplier specifies.
solutions.ur: Battery aur inverter ka firmware supplier ki bataye versions tak update karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

meaning.en: The battery management system itself has reported a fault, so the pack is taken out of service.
meaning.ur: Battery management system ne khud fault report kiya hai, is liye pack service se bahar ho gaya hai.

causes.en: BMS module internal fault or BMS system-level fault.
causes.ur: BMS module ka internal fault ya BMS system level ka fault.
Cell voltage sensing line abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Read the BMS status bit and the reported cell voltages in the app before anything else.
solutions.ur: Pehle app se BMS status bit aur reported cell voltages parhein.

solutions.en: Power down completely, then power up again and check whether the BMS fault is latched.
solutions.ur: Puri tarah power down karke dobara power up karein aur dekhein ke BMS fault latch hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: Inspect the BMS CAN harness and connectors for water, corrosion or a loose pin.
solutions.ur: BMS CAN harness aur connectors mein paani, zang ya dhila pin check karein.

solutions.en: If it returns after all of the above, the BMS module must be replaced - contact after-sales.
solutions.ur: Agar upar ke sab steps ke baad bhi wapas aaye to BMS module replace karna hoga, after-sales se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults
